mapper.sql: id, create_time, update_time, create_user_name, create_user_id, update_user_name, update_user_id, version, is_deleted, warehouse_id, virtual_warehouse_id, sku_id, sku_no, dict_inventory_status, qty
mapper.select:
select string_agg(vi.id, ',') as indexId, vi.sku_id as skuId, vi.warehouse_id as warehouseId, vi.virtual_warehouse_id as virtualWarehouseId from virtual_inventory vi left join virtual_warehouse vw on vi.virtual_warehouse_id = vw.id and vw.is_deleted = false
${params.sqlMap.default} and vi.is_deleted = false
and vi.qty != 0
${params.permissionSql}
group by vi.sku_id,vi.warehouse_id,vi.virtual_warehouse_id order by
${item.field} ${item.sort}
vi.sku_id

select diff.invId, diff.sku_id,pd.sku_no as skuNo, pd.name as productName, diff.warehouse_id, wh.name as warehouseName, wh.kingdee_warehouse_code as warehouseCode, diff.usableQty, COALESCE(frozenDiff.frozenQty,0) as frozenQty, diff.usableQty + COALESCE(frozenDiff.frozenQty,0) as realQty, COALESCE(inv.usableQty,0) as distributionQty, (COALESCE(diff.usableQty,0) + COALESCE(frozenDiff.frozenQty,0) - COALESCE(inv.usableQty,0)) as unDistributionQty from (select min(vi.id) AS invId, vi.sku_id, vi.warehouse_id, sum(vi.qty) as usableQty from inventory vi where vi.is_deleted = false and vi.dict_inventory_status = 'usable' group by vi.sku_id , vi.warehouse_id) diff left join (select vi.sku_id, vi.warehouse_id, sum(vi.qty) as frozenQty from inventory vi where vi.is_deleted = false and vi.dict_inventory_status = 'frozen' group by vi.sku_id , vi.warehouse_id) frozenDiff on frozenDiff.sku_id = diff.sku_id and frozenDiff.warehouse_id = diff.warehouse_id left join ( select inv.sku_id , inv.warehouse_id ,sum(inv.qty) as usableQty from virtual_inventory inv where inv.is_deleted = false group by inv.sku_id , inv.warehouse_id ) inv on inv.sku_id = diff.sku_id and inv.warehouse_id = diff.warehouse_id left join product_detail pd on diff.sku_id = pd.id and pd.is_deleted = false left join warehouse wh on diff.warehouse_id = wh.id and wh.is_deleted = false
${params.sqlMap.default}
and COALESCE(inv.usableQty,0) > COALESCE(diff.usableQty,0) + COALESCE(frozenDiff.frozenQty,0)
and COALESCE(diff.usableQty,0) + COALESCE(frozenDiff.frozenQty,0) >= COALESCE(inv.usableQty,0)
ORDER BY diff.invId
